title: RWAs buck DeFi slowdown as tokenized assets gain traction
message_html: RWAs buck DeFi slowdown as tokenized assets gain traction ...
snippet: Tokenized real-world assets moved beyond issuance as RWA deposits more than tripled to $7.4 billion, while lending and trading activity expanded despite a broader industry slowdown.

title: KuCoin rolls out stablecoin gift cards
snippet: Seychelles-based crypto currency exchange KuCoin has rolled out a stablecoin gift card that enables businesses to distribute USDT and USDC globally for customer rewards, promotional campaigns and employee incentives.
